plugins.name: cpa-skills
plugins.description: Thirteen skills for accountants, tax professionals, controllers, and auditors. Every skill runs entirely on the local machine and refuses to deliver a workpaper that does not tie: bank statement extraction with a completeness proof, bank reconciliation, tax return review with evidence for every item tested, year-over-year variance with enforced explanation quality, full-population journal entry anomaly scanning, Schedule K-1 extraction footed to the entity return, four-way payroll tax reconciliation, reproducible audit sampling, three-way match across POs and invoices and receipts, fixed asset and depreciation tie-out, sales tax reconciliation with nexus screening, AR aging tie-out with every bucket recomputed, and revenue tracing from the ledger to invoice, contract and cash.
